parts.title: Reported predecessor of 32022623 NG9-3 front subframe

relationships.conditions: One version of the eSaabParts product page lists this predecessor; other retrieved presentation omits it. No distinct OEM corroboration found.

requirements: Do not infer universal MY2003–2011 compatibility, including Z18XE.
Require VIN and 2005 engine mount configuration verification.
parts.notes: Predecessor identifier only, not a confirmed physical-interchange mapping or primary part application.

parts.title: Early NG9-3 convertible front axle stay
requirements: Verify exact CV chassis-suffix interpretation; supplier diagram only.
Compare installation and chassis bracing before attempting replacement.
parts.notes: Diagram says up to chassis --56000012 and years 2003–2005; CV launched during this period and broader catalogue year range must not be taken as definitive availability.

parts.title: Later NG9-3 convertible front axle stay
requirements: Seller says Arc/Vector/Aero and Linear with sport chassis only.
Confirm 8-character suffix, engine and sport chassis; not a universal CV substitute.
parts.notes: Supplier specifies chassis from 56000013 and engine/trim restrictions. No proof this directly replaces 12831387.

parts.title: Front-floor hexagon screw, early NG9-3 chassis limit
requirements: Section drawing callout 25; joint to be confirmed.
Do not substitute as a front subframe body bolt without factory callout and spec.
parts.notes: Supplier lists a chassis-boundary screw in the front-floor diagram; not a verified subframe mounting bolt.

parts.title: Jack support listed in NG9-3 front-floor diagram
requirements: Retailer lists quantity 4; inspection of attached body steel is required.
Not proof a corroded lift point is safe to use.
parts.notes: Retailer catalogue part identity only. Source does not establish standalone repair sufficiency for corroded sill.
